blocks.text: Sullivan Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

They had a median $756 per square foot, a median year built of 2004 and a median strata fee of $434 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses and 60 condos and townhomes listed in Sullivan Heights. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Sullivan Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes had 15% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 4.8% of the 63 homes listed in Sullivan Heights and condos and townhomes made up 95.2%; of the 9 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 5 in June to 3 in October 2026 (−40.0%); condos and townhomes was little changed, 60 in June and 60 in October 2026 (+0.0%).

faq.q: What did condos in Sullivan Heights sell for?
faq.a: 97 condos sold in Sullivan Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $567,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Sullivan Heights?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
